decision.summary: A multi-axis temporary offset is evident: U drops sharply (~−15 MAD) near index 590, accompanied by smaller upward steps in N (~+7.6 MAD) and E (~+4.8 MAD); all three axes remain offset through index 629. No opposing return is observed before index 630, and the U component does not recover within the allowed context [553,670]; thus the interval is uncertain. The onset aligns with the numerical jump candidate at index 590, and the sustained interior (590–629) is clearly distinct from background noise.

intervals.observation: U shows abrupt drop starting at ~589–590 (coincident with N/E upward steps), sustained plateau until ~629; N and E show correlated upward steps beginning ~588–590, persisting through plateau. Return not observed within allowed context (U remains depressed at 630+; N/E do not revert).
